title: Two blocks, 50 N on the bottom one, frictionless floor: the top one slips
about: top: a = μg = 3.92; bottom: a = (F − μ m_top g)/m_bottom = (50 − 7.84)/3

lines.say: Imagine two blocks, one on top of the other, on the floor.
We apply 50 newtons on the bottom block.
The top block is 2 kg and the bottom block is 3 kg.
The coefficient of friction between the blocks is 0.4.

notes: the top block slides on the block below
